```yaml
name: Test flake

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v3
        with:
          install_flags: '--extra-experimental-features nix-command flakes'

      - name: Setup Nix cache
        uses: DeterminateSystems/magic-nix-cache-action@main
        with:
          use-gha-cache: true

      - name: Run nix flake check
        run: nix flake check

      - name: Test dev shell initialization
        run: nix develop . --command true
```
